question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution: The correct option to fill in the blank No. 2 is "seemed" as it makes the sentence grammatically and contextually correct. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **Seemed**: This is the past tense of the verb "seem," which is used to indicate an apparent state or condition, or to make something appear in a certain way. For instance, "She seemed happy," suggests that she appeared to be happy, but it doesn't necessarily mean that she was truly happy. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Perhaps**: This is an adverb that indicates uncertainty or possibility. It is used when you are not certain about something. For example, in the sentence, "Perhaps it will rain later," the speaker is suggesting that it might rain later, but they aren't sure. • **Besides**: This can function as a preposition or an adverb. As a preposition, it means 'in addition to' or 'apart from'. For example, "Besides basketball, she also plays tennis," meaning she plays tennis in addition to basketball. As an adverb, it can mean 'moreover' or 'also'. For example, "I don't want to go to the party. Besides, I have to study," where 'besides' introduces an additional reason. • **Thought**: This is the past tense of the verb "think," which means to have a particular belief or idea. It also refers to the act or process of considering, believing, or remembering something. For example, "I thought you were going to the store," suggests that the speaker previously believed that the other person was going to the store. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** __ • **Seemed:** "Seemed" का अर्थ होता है** "प्रतीत होना"**. यह शब्द एक स्थिति या अवस्था को दिखाने या किसी चीज़ को एक निश्चित तरह से प्रदर्शित करने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाता है। • उदाहरण के लिए, "वह खुश प्रतीत हुई," का अर्थ होता है कि वह खुश दिख रही थी, लेकिन यह अवश्य नहीं है कि वह वास्तव में खुश थी। • **Perhaps: **"Perhaps" का मतलब होता है "शायद" या "संभव". यह तब इस्तेमाल किया जाता है जब आप किसी चीज़ के प्रति निश्चित नहीं होते। • उदाहरण के लिए, "शायद बाद में बारिश हो सकती है," का मतलब होता है कि शायद बाद में बारिश हो सकती है, लेकिन वक्ता सुनिश्चित नहीं है। • **Besides:** "Besides" का अर्थ होता है "के अलावा" या "साथ ही". यह एक पूर्वसर्ग या क्रिया-विशेषण के रूप में कार्य कर सकता है। • उदाहरण के लिए, "बास्केटबॉल के अलावा, वह टेनिस भी खेलती है," का मतलब होता है कि वह बास्केटबॉल के अलावा टेनिस भी खेलती है। • **Thought:** "Thought" का अर्थ होता है "सोचा". यह "सोचना" के क्रिया का भूतकाल है, जो किसी विशेष विचार या आस्था को दर्शता है। यह किसी चीज़ को विचार करने, विश्वास करने, या याद करने की प्रक्रिया को भी दर्शाता है। • उदाहरण के लिए, "मैंने सोचा कि आप दुकान जा रहे थे," का अर्थ होता है कि वक्ता ने पहले सोचा था कि दूसरा व्यक्ति दुकान जा रहा था। 47:T17cc, The correct answer for the blank in question number 3 is** "around".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • In this context,** "around"** is the most appropriate choice because it accurately conveys the intended meaning of an oppressive, enclosing force. • The phrase "tighten its grip around me" is idiomatic and paints a picture of the feeling of restriction and confinement that the speaker is feeling, as if being trapped or squeezed by the palace.
